scenarios.title: IBAN file sent to a personal Gmail at night
scenarios.narrative:
You are an L1 analyst on a bank data leakage monitoring team.
At 23:40 a High DLP alert fires for rule "Customer IBAN - external email".
A Finance user sent an XLSX with 2,300 IBANs to an @gmail.com address.
The message was delivered and the file is labelled Confidential - Customer.
The shift manager asks whether this is just another Finance false positive.
artifacts: DLP alert: rule=Customer IBAN - external email; severity=High; matches=2300; label=Confidential - Customer
History: no similar alerts for this user in 90 days; no approval ticket found
scenarios.debrief:
A senior analyst validates the alert from logged metadata before acting.
They do not contact the user until the picture is complete.
A personal recipient domain makes the alert real regardless of the sender team.
They preserve the email and logs, decide containment proportionately and keep the incident manager informed.
